name: FileConflictDialog
description:
The conflict step alone, for a plain Save that opens no dialog: someone else's write got there
first, and nothing has closed, so no edits are lost. It says who won and offers Replace, Save a
copy and Compare; `FileDialog` shows it when `onSave` returns a conflict.
signature: ({ open, name, current, onResolve, onCompare }: FileConflictDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: current
props.description: The file as it is now, or null if it has gone.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Called once with the choice. Escape is `cancel`. Close it by setting `open`.
